# Memory Drop

> Private event photo and video collection. Guests upload through a link or QR code. Only the organisers and invited admins can view the gallery. Files land in the owner's Google Drive. Memory Drop does not provide Google storage or quota.

## Site

- Home: /
- Privacy policy: /privacy
- Terms: /terms
- Guest demo: /upload/demo

## Product notes

- Guests: upload only (no gallery access, no accounts)
- Admins: view, download, delete
- Storage: connected Google Drive account (owner's quota)
- Contact: hello@imadkazi.co.uk
